about: Cloudflare's answers to the Workers AI login probe GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/ai/models/search?per_page=1 on api.cloudflare.com. The 'recorded' cases were captured live on 2026-10-21 (cf-ray a4e25c44bd9a034d-MAD) with FAKE credentials only: account id 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef and made-up tokens. The 'documented' case was not reproducible without a real token; its shape follows Cloudflare's API envelope and wrangler's Workers AI handling (packages/wrangler/src/ai/fetcher.ts treats a 403 with error code 1031 as missing permissions).
